title: Still closed
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: The slough again. The same flagger. He recognizes the Datsun before it stops. 'Still closed till it drops.' Wood asks if he's ever seen it drop. The flagger says once. In '96.

panels.composition: 101 at the slough, flooded, the FLAGGER in orange, the Datsun slowing. Rain in sheets.

balloons.text: Ninety-six. We were in the cafeteria.

panels.composition: The Datsun turning around. The flagger, small, in the rain, waiting for a thing he saw once.
